title: The Long Grass
description: Let the meadow grow into tall grass, find the half-hidden path network, climb its wooden walk and emerge into open fields.

signs.text:
The short meadow
The first path is easy to read

Where the grass grows tall
Read the clear block tops beneath the grass

The hidden path network
A side opening returns beneath the main trail

The wooden grass walk
Climb onto the clear boards above the grass

The clear field
The path and sky open up again
